title: BPW-2026-0490
text:
[BUREAU OF ENGINEERING]
BPW-2026-0490
CD ALL
MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING (MOU) – STATEWIDE ELECTRONIC COURIER UNIVERSAL RECORDING ENVIRONMENT
Recommending the Board:
DELEGATE signature authority to the City Engineer to execute the MOU between the Bureau of Engineering, and the counties of Los Angeles, Orange, Riverside, and San Diego; and
FORWARD this report to the City Council for approval, as the duration of this contract is for five years with an option to extend it for an additional year.
